name: study-tracker
description: Local-first study tracker with spaced-repetition revisions, timers and streaks.

scripts.predev: npm run build -w @study/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @study/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @study/api" "npm run dev -w @study/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @study/shared && npm run build -w @study/api && npm run build -w @study/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @study/shared && npm run typecheck -w @study/api && npm run typecheck -w @study/web
